answers.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
answers.evidence: Of the 32 judged findings (tool findings F-0001, F-0018, F-0019 excluded), 22 map to seeded defects, 6 are real but not seeded and 4 are not a problem (F-0041, F-0045, F-0046, F-0086), so precision = 28/32 = 0.875 and strict precision = 22/32 = 0.69. Recall by meaning is 12/14 from judged findings (D02 is found only by tool F-0019, D13 not at all), or 13/14 counting the tool findings.

answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply opens with a numbered 'Fix first (could lose people their slot or get them turned away at the gate)' list (double-tap cancel, permit, done page, hold, past slots), then the WCAG blockers, then a scope decision. It names what needs a person: 'Whether this fails WCAG 2.2.1 needs a person to decide' and a 'Not covered' section (real VoiceOver/TalkBack, real large-text settings, exact hold time, CJK input, real residents).

mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px (slot grid)
mapping.reason: The slot grid runs about 15 px past a 320 px viewport and the page scrolls sideways, which is the seeded narrow-width grid overflow.

mapping.title: '20 slots free' status message not announced
mapping.reason: The live region is created along with the text, so screen readers are never told the day's slot count. That is the seeded unannounced status line.

mapping.title: No visible focus indicator on slot buttons
mapping.reason: Tab focus on the '08:00' slot changes no pixels, so the slot buttons show no focus.

mapping.title: Focus order jumps back to '08:20 Few left'
mapping.reason: Focus jumps around the grid because 'Few left' slots are shown out of their document order. The instructions assign focus jumping around the grid to D10.

mapping.title: Cancelled booking page still headed 'Booked' with gate instructions
mapping.reason: D09 includes the done page that, after a second press cancels the booking, is still titled 'Booked' and says 'Show this at the gate', with only a small status line. This finding describes that same misleading outcome.

mapping.title: Expired-hold error gives no way forward and blanks the slot
mapping.reason: When the hold lapses, Book says 'This slot is no longer available.' and the slot row turns to a dash, so the slot is dropped without explanation. This is the seeded hold-expiry defect.

mapping.title: Slot hold is a hidden time limit
mapping.reason: No page states the hold length, shows time remaining or warns before it ends. This is the five-minute hold running out unseen.

mapping.title: Booked page does not repeat day, time or vehicle
mapping.reason: The done page shows only the reference and gate instructions, not the day, slot or vehicle booked. This is exactly D14.

mapping.title: No loading state while a day's slots are fetched
mapping.reason: The Slots section is blank for about a second with no loading indicator after a day is chosen. This is the wait itself with nothing saying slots are coming.

mapping.title: Single-choice groups built as independent aria-pressed toggle buttons
mapping.reason: Day, slot and vehicle are one-of-many choices exposed as separate toggle buttons. Screen-reader users are not told that only one can be chosen, nor that pressing one silently unpresses another, and keyboard users must tab through every one of the roughly 29 slots. This is a genuine semantics and keyboard burden that the seeded defects do not cover.

mapping.title: Permit not checked on the vehicle step; error only after booking
mapping.reason: Next accepts an empty or invalid permit, and the rule is enforced only on the confirm page, which has no permit field. That is D07.

mapping.title: Booking-time error-summary items have no link to where they can be fixed
mapping.reason: The central example is the permit error on the confirm page, which can only be fixed on another page with no way there given. That matches D07's 'the resident has to work out that Change vehicle is the way back'. It also touches the expired-hold message (D08).

mapping.title: Today's slots that can no longer be booked shown as free
mapping.reason: Early slots today are offered as free and refused only by the confirm page's Book handler: 'The HH:MM slot today can no longer be booked.'

mapping.title: Second press of Book records the booking as cancelled
mapping.reason: A second press during the 1.5 s wait turns into 'Cancel booking', and the resident lands on a 'Booked' page for a cancelled booking. This is the core of D09.

mapping.title: Book button gives no visible sign of the 1.5 s submission
mapping.reason: Book does nothing visible while the booking is made. The instructions assign this to D09.

mapping.title: Five-minute slot hold never shown, warned about or extendable
mapping.reason: The five-minute hold is not stated, has no countdown or warning, and is checked only when Book fires, which then clears the slot. This is D08.

mapping.title: 'Few left' tag colours drift to low-contrast amber
mapping.reason: The runtime amber pair for the 'Few left' tag is about 3.0:1 in light mode and 3.4:1 in dark mode, below 4.5:1 for 16 px bold text. This is the seeded tag-contrast defect.

mapping.title: Waste-limit hint attached to a generic div
mapping.reason: The finding itself says the limits are exposed in the checkbox names ('Rubble (up to four bags)', 'Mattresses (up to two)') and that the hint is read inside the group. Residents lose no information, so this is a markup nicety with no user harm.

mapping.title: Vehicle-step error-summary links target unfocusable containers
mapping.reason: Activating an error link moves focus to the body, not to the vehicle or waste control, so a screen-reader user is not taken to the field to fix. That is a genuine error-recovery barrier the seeded defects do not cover.

mapping.title: 'Few left' badge on a single slot has no clear meaning
mapping.reason: This is speculative: 'Few left' on a time window reads naturally as few places left in it, the usual booking pattern, and the tag is meant to say a slot is about to go. The review itself says whether residents understand it still needs testing.

mapping.title: Vehicle step does not show the day and time just chosen
mapping.reason: The choice was made one step earlier and is repeated on the check-and-book step, which is the standard pattern. The finding shows no harm to residents, so it is a matter of design preference.

mapping.title: Permit field stays visible and unexplained after 'Car'
mapping.reason: The permit rule lives only behind the icon-only (i) button, the field gives no 'only for vans and trailers' cue, and Next proceeds with it empty. This is part of the permit-rule defect D07.

mapping.title: Permit field shown to every resident regardless of vehicle
mapping.reason: The permit field does not say when it applies, and the rule is only inside the collapsed 'About vans and trailers' panel. This is the permit rule and permit field covered by D07.

mapping.title: Permit help behind an unlabelled info icon that looks like a vehicle option
mapping.reason: The only explanation of the permit sits behind an icon-only 'i' button. D07 says the rule 'is said only behind an icon-only info button'.

mapping.title: Permit help says 'apply on the council site' with no link
mapping.reason: A resident with a van or trailer is told to get a permit but given no link, page or phone route, so they cannot find out how to get the number they need to book. Making the rule visible (D07) would not fix this.

mapping.title: Waste row has no change link on the confirm summary
mapping.reason: A resident who wants to change their waste on the check page has no change action, and 'Change vehicle' does not say it also covers waste. This is a genuine, if minor, error-correction gap that is not seeded.

mapping.title: Returning to the slot page resets the day to Today
mapping.reason: 'Change slot' (and 'Back to the slots') open the first step on Today with no slot selected, forgetting the chosen Saturday. This is D12.

mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel a booking by reference
mapping.reason: Residents who book in the evening and need to change or cancel can only phone on weekdays 09:00 to 17:00, while the centre opens most days. That blocks a core task for these users, and it is not seeded.

mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel an existing booking
mapping.reason: This duplicates F-0078: no route lets a resident open a booking by reference to change or cancel it, only a weekday phone line. It is a genuine gap in a core task that is not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: No page states how long a chosen slot is held
mapping.reason: The booking can expire ('This slot is no longer available.'), but no page mentions a hold or time limit. This is the hold running out unseen.

mapping.title: Slot grid fixed at seven columns at 1280 px
mapping.reason: This is a desktop layout drift from DESIGN.md that leaves empty space. The slots stay usable, so residents, mostly on phones, suffer no usability harm. It is a matter of design fidelity.

mapping.title: Info button styled as a fourth vehicle option
mapping.reason: The finding is about the icon-only (i) permit-info button that looks like another vehicle choice. That is the same control D07 says hides the permit rule.

mapping.title: axe colour contrast on the 'Few left' tag (3.02:1)
mapping.reason: #bd7d0f on #fbefda at 16 px bold is 3.02:1 against the required 4.5:1. This is the 'Few left' tag contrast.

mapping.title: No progress during a 1.2 s operation after 'Car with trailer'
mapping.reason: Choosing 'Car with trailer' starts a 1.2 s wait with nothing shown. This is the delayed permit field, which the instructions assign to D07.

mapping.title: Layout shift above 0.1 on / moving #opening
mapping.reason: Lab CLS is 0.169, with #opening shifted when the slots arrive. This is the seeded layout shift.
